Notes
Spa Manager

Comis Hotel & Golf Resort is seeking an experienced and commercially focused Spa Manager to lead our spa operation and deliver an exceptional guest experience. This is a hands-on role combining spa management with treatment delivery.

Key responsibilities include managing daily spa operations, leading and developing the spa team, delivering treatments, overseeing bookings and rotas, driving retail and revenue performance, maintaining high presentation standards, and supporting the spa’s social media presence.

The ideal candidate will hold NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent), have previous spa supervisory or management experience, strong treatment skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for guest care and wellness. Knowledge of Elemis products would be an advantage.

The role requires flexibility, including weekends and busy operational periods.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary dependent on experience
• Staff benefits and hotel discounts
• Service charge participation
• Free onsite parking
• Training and development opportunities
• Supportive working environment within a growing resort

To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to:
HR@comishotel.com

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Salary
£24,013 - £28,507
End Date
04 June 2026
Notes
We are looking to recruit a dependable and responsible part-time Cleaner to join our team working within the Sheltered Housing Complex(es). Candidates must have knowledge and experience of domestic and/or commercial cleaning practices, with the ability to work on their own, under instruction and as part of a team.
In order to apply for this role, please do so by completing an online application using the Job Train portal, which can be accessed by visiting the Council’s website www.douglas.gov.im. Please contact the HR Section if you require any further information (hr@douglas.gov.im) or 01624 696455.

Essential:
Knowledge of cleaning practices, use of relevant chemicals and associated safety principles.
Knowledge of household or commercial cleaning practices.
Appreciation of safe manual handling techniques.
Ability to work on own, under instruction and as part of a team.
Ability to exercise care in the use of information acquired in the course of official duties and to protect information held in confidence.
Ability to perform cleaning tasks including mopping, vacuuming, cleaning toilet areas, replenishing consumable items and dusting.
Ability to read labels and equipment operating instructions.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and complete a planned routine of tasks within an allocated time.
Skill in operating basic equipment.
Flexible with ability to work in the various locations, when required.
Desirable:
Knowledge of cleaning practices and standards within a care home/sheltered housing complex.
Full clean valid driving license.
Public Sector experience.

Our client is seeking a Deputy Money Laundering Reporting Officer (DMLRO) to provide specialised support to the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) in the execution of essential frameworks, minimum standards, and processes required for compliant business operations. This role is crucial in preventing operational losses, fines, penalties, or reputational damage to the organisation, thereby reinforcing its competitive advantage. The DMLRO may also deputise for the MLRO, representing the organisation with key stakeholders such as the Financial Services Authority. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the effective fulfilment of obligations under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2008 and the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Code 2019, alongside related AML/CFT legislation and guidance. This position is not open to relocation or sponsorship and is only available for residents of the Isle of Man. The role presents an opportunity for individuals with a strong background in anti-fraud and compliance to further their career in a dynamic environment. Please email team@itchyfeet.im or follow the link for further information and for details on how to apply https://itchyfeetoffshore.com/jobs/36462-deputy-money-laundering-reporting-officer-isle-of-man/

Altenar is a leading sportsbook software provider delivering flexible, fully managed solutions to gaming operators globally. With a strong track record of growth and innovation, we operate at the intersection of technology and gaming.

We are looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join our in-house team with strong communication skills. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of legal matters, work closely with the business, and play a hands-on role in shaping how legal supports a growing international company. 

This position is suited to a proactive and detail-oriented lawyer who is comfortable working independently, taking accountability, and driving continuous improvement in legal processes and documentation.

Key responsibilities:

Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS/software licensing, partnerships, and supplier contracts.
Act as a key legal contact for business stakeholders, providing clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused advice.
Take ownership of legal support for designated business areas.
Identify and implement improvements to legal processes, workflows, and ways of working.
Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and internal guidance.
Collaborate with a multi-jurisdictional legal team.
Manage external counsel and support disputes where required.
Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments in the gaming and technology sectors.
Support strategic business initiatives, including new product development.

Skills & Experience:

4-6 years PQE (post qualification experience).
as a solicitor, advocate or equivalent required – this is a guideline so if you feel that you are suitable, please still apply.
Strong grounding in commercial and contract law. 
Experience in the gaming industry/software development industry is advantageous but not essential.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage priorities. 
Experience improving legal processes, templates, or ways of working is highly desirable. 
Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills.
Ability to provide practical, business-focused advice in a clear and concise manner.
Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively across different jurisdictions and cultures.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and interest in the gaming/technology space.

Legal Technology & Innovation:

Experience working with legal technology tools (e.g. CLM systems, document automation) is advantageous.
Interest in leveraging AI and legal technology to improve legal service delivery and efficiency is desirable. 

Benefits:

Competitive compensation and benefits package.
Discretionary bonus linked to performance.
Stable and flexible working environment.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
International, collaborative team environment.
Varied and  engaging work.

For more details and to apply contact job@altenar.com

Our client is seeking a Compliance Officer to support governance, regulatory compliance, and risk management across the business. Reporting to the eGaming Compliance Manager, the role involves overseeing client compliance obligations, ensuring regulatory deadlines are met, and identifying and escalating risks in line with Company procedures.
Key responsibilities include supporting gambling licence applications, onboarding, client reviews, SAR submissions, AML/CFT monitoring, and ensuring compliance with GSC returns and wider regulatory requirements. The role may also involve holding approved regulatory positions such as AML/CFT Compliance Officer and MLRO, while providing guidance to internal teams and clients on compliance matters.
You will assist with regulatory inspections, policy development, and maintaining strong relationships with regulators and stakeholders, while also mentoring junior team members and supporting team development.
The ideal candidate will have strong compliance experience, preferably within eGaming, financial services, or fiduciary services, with a solid understanding of AML/CFT legislation, Isle of Man regulatory requirements, and risk management. Strong communication, organisation, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with a proactive and detail-focused approach. Enforce the Laws of the Game:
Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Ensure Player Safety:
Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Work with the Officiating Team:
Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Manage Player and Team Conduct:
Handle dissent, manage technical areas, and communicate decisions clearly to players and coaches.

Apply Match Procedures:
Conduct pre-match checks (pitch, equipment, players), manage substitutions, keep time, and restart play correctly.

Report and Administration:
Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Professional Standards:
Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

For more details and to apply contact Referee@isleofmanfa.com or 01624649394

Notes
We are looking for a reliable and proactive Multi-Skilled Operative to support the delivery of essential environmental and public works services across Ramsey Town. This varied, hands-on role includes street cleaning, litter collection, maintenance of parks, housing areas, beaches and public spaces, as well as assisting with signage, car parks, and general upkeep. You will also support refuse collection services, operate vehicles and equipment (training provided), and help ensure all areas are safe, clean and well maintained.
The role involves working outdoors in all conditions and contributing to key activities such as event set-up (including TT and seasonal events), additional cleaning and waste services, and responding to adverse weather by assisting with flooding, gritting, and safety measures. You will be expected to work safely at all times, carry out routine vehicle and equipment checks, and work collaboratively across teams as required.
The ideal candidate will be practical, flexible and team-oriented, with a strong work ethic and willingness to undertake a wide range of duties. A full, valid HGV driving licence is essential. 
We are seeking someone with experience in general labouring activities and safe working practices, who is physically fit and able to carry out manual tasks in all weather conditions. Strong communication skills, a good understanding of health and safety, and the ability to follow instructions are essential. Desirable qualifications include relevant certifications such as pesticide use and chainsaw operation, along with experience using machinery, tools, or driving plant equipment. A positive attitude, reliability, and the ability to work well within a team are key to success in this role.
For an information pack and application form, please contact HR@rtc.gov.im.  The closing date is Friday 29th May 2026.

Notes
Little Diamonds is seeking a dedicated, organised and passionate Cook to join our team, preparing nutritious meals for up to 100 children each day. This is a key role within our nursery, helping to support children’s health, wellbeing and development through high-quality food. At Little Diamonds, we believe that healthy eating plays an essential part in every child’s learning journey. We are looking for someone who shares our commitment to providing balanced, wholesome meals in a warm and caring environment. You will be responsible for planning, preparing and serving freshly cooked meals and snacks in line with children’s dietary needs, allergies and nutritional guidelines. You will work closely with the management team to ensure menus are varied, nutritious and compliant with current food safety standards. This is a busy role, requiring excellent organisation and the ability to work efficiently while maintaining the highest standards. The Ideal Candidate will have experience in a busy kitchen environment (nursery, school, care home or similar); a minimum of Level 2 Food Hygiene qualification; knowledge of children’s nutritional needs (desirable); strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently; a calm, positive and reliable approach and a genuine interest in supporting children’s wellbeing. If you are passionate about preparing nutritious food and would like to be part of the Little Diamonds team, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a short covering letter outlining your experience to apply recruitment@littlediamonds-iom.net

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team.

The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times.

Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 2 and 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position.

Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities.

Why Join Prospero Group?

We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave.  Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us.

To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

We are seeking an experienced and motivated individual to lead our Arborist team and deliver a high-quality arboriculture service across the City. As Head Arborist, you will be responsible for managing a team of professionals undertaking a full range of arboricultural operations, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with industry standards. The role includes planning and programming work schedules, maintaining accurate records, liaising with stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with health and safety requirements.

The successful candidate will be an effective leader with strong communication and organisational skills and significant experience in arboriculture, including tree inspections, risk assessments, climbing, pruning, and the use of specialist equipment. Previous supervisory or management experience is essential. You must be computer literate and capable of managing operational documentation and reporting. The role requires a high level of physical fitness and a willingness to work outdoors in all weather conditions, as well as flexibility to work outside normal working hours when required. A full, clean driving licence and relevant certifications are essential.

A Relocation Package is available to assist successful off-Island applicant(s) relocating from the UK. 

To apply, please do so by completing an online application using the Job Train portal, which can be accessed by visiting: https://www.jobtrain.co.uk/douglascitycouncil/Job/JobDetail?JobId=110 - 

Please contact the HR Section if you require any further information: (hr@douglas.gov.im) or 01624 696455.

Ability to manage a portfolio of clients effectively. Strong ability to work to deadlines with excellent prioritisation skills. Outstanding attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The Deputy Money Laundering Reporting Officer (“DMLRO”) supports the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (“MLRO”) in the effective discharge of the firm’s obligations under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2008, the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Code 2019, and related AML/CFT legislation and guidance. Notes
We are currently seeking a An Assistant Manager to join our busy General Accountancy Practice and Corporate Service Provider.
About the Role:
This role is ideal for a newly qualified accountant or someone with early post-qualification experience who is looking to broaden their expertise across general accountancy and trust services while developing managerial and leadership skills.
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee a small team of up to five staff, reporting directly to a manager and/or Director.
Oversee and reviewing preparation of Isle of Man payroll for clients.
Manage and maintain strong client relationships across a varied portfolio.
Oversee client engagements from both the general accountancy and trust services business.
Ensure timely preparation and review of financial statements.
Oversee and review taxation and VAT returns and associated assessments.
Be involved in the administration of client companies, varying widely in size and complexity.
Organise, co-ordinate, and allocate work for junior staff.
Review work completed by junior team members and to provide guidance and feedback.
Assist with the supervision, training, and development of junior staff.
Participate in staff appraisals, internal training sessions, and management meetings.
Maintain regular and effective communication with Managers and Directors with all relevant client matters.
Ensure clients comply with firm and regulatory requirements, liaising with the Compliance team regarding due diligence and KYC documentation.
Always Represent CM Partners and CM Trust professionally in a managerial capacity.

Minimum Education and Experience: 

Newly qualified ACCA or ACA, or up to two years’ post-qualification experience.
Practice trained would be beneficial.

Required Skills:
Strong communication and organisational skills.
Ability to lead, supervise, and develop junior members of staff.
High levels of discretion, diplomacy, and professional confidence.
Keen to broaden experience across all aspects of general accountancy and trust services for high-value clients.
Audit experience is not required.

Salary;
A competitive salary will be offered, based on qualifications and experience.
How to Apply:
For more information or to apply, please contact:
careers@cmiom.com

Notes
Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant (ACA) - ISLE OF MAN. 

About to Graduate? 
Finishing your PhD?
What Next?

From small businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, handling complex audit procedures across the UKI industry sectors.

At EY in the Isle of Man, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.  

The opportunity:

EY’s practice in the Isle of Man is experiencing significant growth. Based in the heart of the Isle of Man, our UKI operation has enjoyed major business wins. With a huge welcome from our clients and increased demand from the UKI industry sectors, the Isle of Man is looking to recruit Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountants starting in August 2026. 

As an Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant in the Isle of Man, you will be a fundamental part of a multi-disciplinary team, working closely with our clients delivering efficient and effective assurance services. What's more you won't always find yourself in a purely office-based role, as we encourage you to work with clients on their own sites when this is practical and efficient. If you are a confident team player, have excellent communications skills, and have a genuine interest in studying towards an accountancy qualification, consider EY.

Your key responsibilities:

You will be expected to execute work efficiently, delivering excellent service and bringing the full breadth of EY's capability to support our UKI industry sector clients. You will train towards obtaining your ACA professional qualification in a supportive and enthusiastic environment.

Skills and attributes for success:  Strong motivation to study towards the ICAEW ACA qualification.

To qualify for the role you must have:  2:1 honours degree in any discipline.

About EY:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Apply: Send CV & Cover Letter to Derek Ware at dware1@im.ey.com

EY’s practice in the Isle of Man is experiencing significant growth. Based in the heart of the Isle of Man, our UKI operation has enjoyed major business wins. With a huge welcome from our clients and increased demand from the UKI industry sectors, the Isle of Man is looking to recruit Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountants starting in August 2026. 

As an Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant in the Isle of Man, you will be a fundamental part of a multi-disciplinary team, working closely with our clients delivering efficient and effective assurance services. What's more you won't always find yourself in a purely office-based role, as we encourage you to work with clients on their own sites when this is practical and efficient. If you are a confident team player, have excellent communications skills, and have a genuine interest in studying towards an accountancy qualification, consider EY.

Your key responsibilities:

You will be expected to execute work efficiently, delivering excellent service and bringing the full breadth of EY's capability to support our UKI industry sector clients. You will train towards obtaining your ACA professional qualification in a supportive and enthusiastic environment.

Skills and attributes for success:  Strong motivation to study towards the ICAEW ACA qualification.

To qualify for the role you must have:  2:1 honours degree in any discipline.

About EY:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Apply: Send CV & Cover Letter to Derek Ware at dware1@im.ey.com

Notes
We offer ATT/CTA, ICAEW or ACCA training contracts to motivated students who want to start a career where they can have a positive impact on their community whilst developing deep expertise and working with industry leaders.

As a consultant you will support engagement leaders by providing administrative and investigative support to ensure effective delivery of assignments in-line with client, statutory, legal and KPMG methodology.

You will be given formal structured professional study support, receive rewards as you pass exams and be exposed to industry leaders as you develop deep expertise of our Financial Services clients.

As a tax consultant you will be responsible for:

Delivering timely work with a focus on quality and efficiency.
Developing and maintaining effective relationships with all colleagues and clients.
Developing and understanding internal and external processes and procedures.
Proactively seeking feedback and opportunity to reflect upon tasks performed.
Applying the knowledge gained through professional studies to work completed.

The skills and experience you will need to thrive as a tax consultant:

5 GCSEs grade A - C (including English and Mathematics).
112 UCAS points (or equivalent).
A 2:1 degree (or higher) if you are a graduate.
The ability to work using initiative, prioritise tasks and adapt to developing business and departmental needs.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Be accountable for own work and career progression.
Proficient knowledge of Excel and other Microsoft Office programmes.

This role is available in any of our three islands: Jersey, Guernsey and Isle of Man.

The advantages of growing your career with KPMG in the Crown Dependencies.

Direct access to leadership from your first day.
Rapid career progression for excellent performers.
Growing opportunities to advance in non-standard career routes as we continue to meet our ambitious growth targets.
Exposure to industry leaders in a Financial Services centre of excellence.
Thriving social networks.
Scenic island locations with little to no commuting time.
Safe, friendly communities.

For more details and to apply contact Khamon@kpmg.com or 01534608403

Our client seeks Bookkeeper to join their Family Office on the Isle of Man. Key Responsibilities: Daily postings of supplier invoices, interbank transfers, cash receipts and payments for all Isle of Man Companies. Daily postings of the Isle of Man Partnerships and Trusts. Posting of investment portfolios and being familiar with posting multi-currency transactions. Preparation of the quarterly VAT returns and liaising with Customs and Excise. Preparation of monthly payment run, keying in payments to the banking system and posting them to the accounting system. Preparation of monthly bank reconciliations for all Isle of Man Companies. Assisting with posting of the daily cash fund Assisting in the preparation of the year end accounts. Assist with ad hoc project work. Ensure service standards and company policies and procedures are adhered to. Key Skills and Experience: AAT or equivalent qualification or someone working towards this qualification. Alternatively, a relevant bookkeeping qualification would be essential with experience working in a bookkeeping / assistant accountant role. Ideally have a working knowledge of Sage accounts software although training will be given on this so is not essential. A good knowledge and ability to work with Excel is essential. Confidentiality is key to this role so the candidate must have a professional outlook and understanding of the importance of confidentiality. The role is to fit into a small team and therefore an ability to adapt to the team dynamics is essential.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16551

Our client seeks a Reconciliations Manager to join their team. Role Profile: Lead a team to ensure that all critical financial reconciliations within the Group is done in a timely, accurate and in accord with accounting standards. In addition, to provide assistance to the subsidiaries in regard to management information and analysis. Key Responsibilities: Overseeing a team, including collaborating with key stakeholders outside of the Finance department, to ensure effective resolution of reconciling items. This includes: IT and Operations, liaising with third party suppliers and finance teams across the Group. Producing balance sheet reconciliations and ensuring unusual discrepancies are resolved in a timely manner or escalated to senior management, as applicable. Contributing to and leading the launch of new automated initiatives, including purchase and sales ledger systems, RPAs, data-analysis tools. Compiling, maintaining and updating the reconciliation matrix to ensure that all critical reconciliations are identified and performed in the Group. Reviewing reconciliations prepared by others, querying the allocation and posting of outstanding and reconciled items. Training members within the team, upskilling individuals to develop their reconciliation skills. Adhering to the month-end timetable to ensure that reconciliations are completed by. Journal posting and month-end reporting activities. Ensuring compliance with internal controls and applicable accounting framework. Processing and timely release of electronic payments whilst ensuring payment release controls are maintained. Participating in adhoc projects as required. Maintain awareness and comply with all anti-money laundering legislation, regulations, policies and procedures relevant to the Group. Comply with all policies and procedures relevant to the role. Key Skills and Experience: Part qualified accountant or actively studying towards an accounting qualification or previous relevant work experience. Excellent excel and numeracy skills. Attention to detail. Excellent communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Knowledge of ERP systems (preferably SUN and Xero).

Our client seeks a Client Accountant to join their team. In this role, you'll manage a diverse portfolio of entities, preparing financial statements and providing expert accounting services. Working with complex multi-currency transactions and sophisticated structures, you'll play a vital role in delivering exceptional client service while developing your expertise in this dynamic sector. Key Responsibilities: Manage the recording of financial information and preparation of financial statements for an allocated portfolio of entities. Maintain accurate day-to-day client ledgers, ensuring all transactions align with source documentation for complex multi-currency transactions. Keep up-to-date accounting records for client entities, paying attention to bank statements, agreements, invoices, and contracts. Liaise with the Administration Team on accounting queries and provide technical assistance as required. Prepare annual financial statements, solvency tests, asset statements, and other ad-hoc financial reporting. Prepare tax returns including UK property holdings with HMRC, IOM tax returns, and other relevant jurisdictional filings. Maintain awareness of changes to relevant financial, legal, and regulatory frameworks. Meet internal deadlines while maintaining high attention to detail and accuracy across all client financial records. Update accounts monitoring systems and maintain comprehensive documentation. Key Skills and Experience: A relevant qualification (e.g., ACCA) or minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role. Preferably fiduciary experience of accounting for company and trust structures. Effective communication skills, both verbal and written. Enquiring mind with ability to question, research, apply, and share learning. High level of accuracy, initiative, and exceptional organisational skills. Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel to intermediate or higher level. Ability to pick up and adapt to various bespoke IT/accounting systems and banking platforms. Excellent organisational skills and ability to meet tight deadlines. Ability to work under pressure and deal with complex issues proactively. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16509

Where You’ll Be: This programme is based in the Isle of Man. Please note that some travel between these locations and the UK may be required as part of the role.
Right to Work: Candidates must already hold the legal right to live and work in the the Isle of Man at the point of application.
Eligibility: You’ll have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a degree in any discipline by the time the programme starts.
Qualifications
Study for a relevant professional finance qualification such as Global Credit Certification (GCC) with the opportunity to take a further qualification in the second year of the programme.  Training and costs are all taken care of. 
At Lloyds Banking Group, we help businesses of every shape and size grow, thrive and prosper. From green finance to commercial lending, we’re supporting the economy at every level. 
 You won’t just hear about the big deals - you’ll be in the room, learning how they’re made, seeing the strategy unfold and being part of the action!
The Crown Dependencies business operates across Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man. We also have some colleagues based within the UK. 
 We serve Corporate, Wealth & Retail clients with a full banking proposition and a strong, local presence supported by the wider Group.
We’re growing fast and acting as a “bank within a bank” inside Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets.  With colleagues across the islands and the UK - all focused on delivering distinctive, locally relevant banking. 
 Two years. Four rotations - Unlimited Learning  
Over two years, you’ll take on four placements across our Crown Dependencies business giving graduates a rare, end-to-end exposure to banking – from building Client Relationships in our Fiduciary, Funds and Corporate & International Private Banking and Product Design to Risk Management.
You’ll undertake work that really matters, from managing client portfolios to analysing performance, supporting financial queries and driving the strategic direction for both the business and our clients. 
Closing date: 5 June 2026  
Start date: Mid-September 2026
What you need to apply - While we do not require a minimum degree achievement, we strongly recommend the ability to be able to demonstrate sound knowledge, understanding technical skills aligned to the role. 
Applications Our application process is designed to help you shine. We want everyone to feel they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity, or culture.

You'll take first line responsibility for team administrators, including objective setting, appraisals, 1:1s, and succession planning, while overseeing client entities and team portfolios and acting as company director and/or bank signatory where required. You'll ensure all CSP obligations, client deadlines and regulatory requirements are met and prioritised, and will support the onboarding and transfer of new business, coordinating with the eGaming Compliance Team on gambling licence applications. Are you a compassionate, enthusiastic person who genuinely cares about making a difference in people’s lives? 
We are looking for dedicated individuals to join our team of Care Support Workers, providing high-quality domiciliary care across the Isle of Man.
As the longest-standing care agency on the island, we pride ourselves on our strong reputation, supportive environment, and the wonderful relationships we’ve built with both our carers and clients.

What we’re looking for:

We are seeking true carers, people who are kind, reliable, and passionate about supporting others to live independently in their own homes. Experience is not essential, as full training will be provided, but the right attitude is everything.

Key requirements:

A caring and compassionate nature.
A positive attitude.
Commitment to delivering exceptional care.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Full, clean driving licence and access to own vehicle (essential due to island-wide clients).

What we offer:

Competitive rates of pay.
Paid holiday – rolled up holiday pay.
Mileage allowance.
Flexible working patterns – including day and night shifts.
Full paid training (no experience required).
Paid supervisions and ongoing support.

Salary up to £75,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 plus Relocation Allowance up to £5,000.

Are you looking for an equine-focused role that offers genuine professional fulfilment alongside an exceptional quality of life? We’re delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for an Equine Veterinary Surgeon to join our thriving practice on the beautiful Isle of Man. This is a varied and rewarding equine-only position, working within a supportive and experienced team where you’ll be encouraged to develop your clinical skills while enjoying a truly unique island lifestyle. For those considering relocation, we offer full support with moving to the Isle of Man, helping to make the transition as smooth and stress-free as possible so you can focus on settling into both your new role and your new home.

Looking for a better work–life balance?

We offer a genuinely flexible approach to working patterns and welcome both full-time and part-time applicants. The full-time role is 38 hours per week, worked over 4 or 5 days, with 1 in 4 Saturday mornings and approximately 1 in 10 nights and weekends on call. Work–life balance is a genuine priority here. You’ll benefit from a competitive salary, generous holiday allowance, and strong CPD support to help you continue developing your equine interests and expertise. Our flexible rota patterns are designed to work around real life — whether that’s school commitments, reduced hours during holidays, or a working pattern that better suits your lifestyle, we’re happy to fix or flex rotas wherever possible. 

Team & Facilities:

You’ll be joining a supportive, friendly and experienced team that values collaboration, mentorship, and a positive working culture. The wider clinical team includes 17 Veterinary Surgeons, 14 Registered Veterinary Nurses, and 20 dedicated support staff, with BVRA-registered members and certificate holders within the group. This equine-only role offers a varied and rewarding caseload, combining ambulatory work in the field with access to excellent facilities and modern diagnostic equipment, enabling you to practice high-quality, progressive equine medicine. You’ll be supported by a knowledgeable team and a learning-focused environment where professional development is actively encouraged and your ideas are valued.

Life on the Isle of Man:

Set against a backdrop of rolling hills, rugged coastlines, and open countryside, the Isle of Man offers a truly special way of life. You’ll become part of a welcoming, close-knit community with a vibrant cultural scene — from the world-famous TT races and music festivals to live shows, local breweries, and a thriving food scene. With endless opportunities for outdoor pursuits, including equestrian activities, cycling, wild swimming, and fitness, it’s easy to build a life here that’s as fulfilling outside of work as it is within it.

Apply via the IVC website or contact taylor.findlay@ivcevidensia.com

Notes
Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

We are seeking friendly and resilient Additional Support Workers to join us across all our services. We have over 9 different houses located both in Eastern and Central parts of the Island where they are located within easy reach of local bus routes. You will be joining a friendly, established team that provides quality support to autistic adults.

We are looking for people who will bring their passion and enthusiasm to the role. Autism Initiatives provide specialist support for people with autism and we are committed to working in partnership to achieve the best possible outcomes.

As an Additional Support Worker you will support with a range of activities which meet the wishes of the people that we support and encourages people with autism to live as independently as possible and be part of their local community. Activities could include: swimming, accessing day trips, gardening, walking groups and many more.

The role of an Additional Support Worker enables you to accept shifts around your availability and other commitments. If you are looking for some variety, flexibility in hours and are keen to make a difference, please get in touch today!

This is a truly rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills and knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit: jobs.autisminitiatives.org

Join a brilliant team on the Isle of Man, committed to supporting autistic people to live as independently as possible and to be part of their local community. Autism Initiatives work positively alongside people with autism, providing specialist services that are tailored to each individual.

We are seeking friendly Support Workers to join us at our Residential services. We have a number of houses located in Central and Northern parts of the Island within easy reach of local bus routes.

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic and will enjoy joining a team that encourages people with autism to enjoy an active lifestyle. Community activities could include swimming, accessing walking groups or trips to the cinema or even camping trips and gorge walking. Support Workers promote health and well-being and support individuals to maintain their home. The support we deliver is flexible and unique to each individual, building on their strengths and driven by their goals.

Experience is not essential, but a genuine desire to making a difference to the lives of people with autism, as well as a positive attitude is. This is truly a rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills, knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

Overview:

Join Woodbourne Dental, an established and highly regarded mixed practice on the Isle of Man. We are offering an exciting opportunity for an Associate Dentist to take over an existing, well-established patient list from our Principal Dentist, who is looking to move to a part-time oversight role. This transition promises a seamless handover and a steady flow of loyal patients, ensuring the new Associate can hit the ground running with a high potential for earnings.

Our Practice Offers:

Market-leading UDA rates, with up to 6,000 UDAs available.
Hand-over of the Principal Dentist's patients, providing an opportunity to hit the ground running with an established patient base.
Significant private treatment income opportunities from a vast number of long-standing patients with a high re-attendance rate across pay-as-you-go and Denplan patients.
A modern, fully digitised practice and state-of-the-art dental technology, including oral scanners.
Benefits:

Exceptional work-life balance in the Isle of Man, known for its stunning countryside, coastlines, and safe, vibrant community.
Extremely low income tax rates, enhancing your take-home pay.
Opportunities for both experienced clinicians and recently qualified dentists to grow and excel.
A professional yet friendly team environment with experienced staff.
Requirements:

GDC registration.
Active NHS performer number or eligibility to obtain one.
Strong commitment to quality patient care and excellent communication skills.
Ability to reliably commute to the practice or relocate to Isle of Man.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent.

Benefits:

Company events.
On-site parking.
Licence/Certification:

GDC registration (ESSENTIAL).
Work Location: In person.

jobs.fullDescription:
Vacancy Information
Reference ID

Job title
Family Support Worker - Maternity Cover
Number Required
1
Firm
Family Action
Hours
Full Time (37hrs/wk)
Address

1
Hours
Full Time (37hrs/wk)
Duration
Temporary
Salary
£33,381 - £36,322
End Date
07 June 2026
Notes
Key Tasks & Responsibilities:

1.	Continuously assess the needs of children, young people, and their parents; supporting a multi-agency approach to assessment and planning. 

2.	Ensure you have an understanding of, and comply with, Family Action’s procedures for promoting and safeguarding the welfare and safety of children and vulnerable adults, undertaking risk assessments and placing children at the centre of your work at all times.

3.	Work in a variety of settings, in particular the home environment, to develop realistic and achievable action plans, in consultation with children, young people and their parents, which are based on their assessed needs and written in a way that is easy for them to understand.

4.	Agree targets, in consultation parents and children, and monitor, evaluate and measure progress against them. Capture evidence of the distance travelled in terms of positive changes, using the Family Star (outcomes measurement tool). 

5.	Work with partner agencies to achieve improved outcomes for families. Communicating effectively; drafting and submitting reports to multi-agency meetings in a time manner; and working collaboratively with multi-agency professionals.

6.	Provide a range of support (both on a one-to-one basis and in groups), using various parenting programmes and evidence-based interventions, based on the needs of the family and the appropriateness of the intervention in line with those needs.

7.	Conduct yourself as an accountable professional; actively participating in supervision, training and appraisal processes and ensuring your knowledge, skills and practice is of a high standard.
8.	Maintain accurate and up to date case records in line with best practice, Family Action’s policies & procedures and our safeguarding standards.

9.	Attend, as required, a range of different multi-agency meetings and participate in, and actively contribute to, the development and delivery of multi-agency plans. Attend team meetings as required.

10.	Be responsive to challenge, advice, feedback and direction as part of your continuous development.
 
11.	Embrace and implement Family Action’s Equality & Diversity Policy in every aspect of your work and positively promote its principles amongst colleagues, service users and other members of the community.

12.	Comply with Family Action’s Health and Safety and Data Protection policies and protect your own and others’ health, safety and welfare.
 
13.	Work flexibly as may be required by the needs of the service and carry out any other reasonable duties as required.

For more details and to apply contact 01624 611568 or visit: https://careers.family-action.org.uk/FamilyAction/JobDescription/UbhLMLzLfuY

Doctor of Chiropractic – Full Time.
Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic, Douglas – Isle of Man.

Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic is looking for a friendly, professional, and motivated Doctor of Chiropractic to join our growing team on a full-time basis. This opportunity is suitable for both new graduates and experienced chiropractors who are passionate about delivering excellent client care and working within a supportive clinic environment.

We are a busy, established clinic based on the Isle of Man with a strong reputation for client-centred care, professionalism, and teamwork. Our clients range from babies to older adults, athletes, professionals, pregnancy and family care, with a focus on long-term health, wellbeing, and function.

This role is ideal for someone who is not only passionate about Chiropractic and delivering exceptional care, but also excited by the opportunity to help build and grow a clinic. The successful candidate must be willing to learn the skills involved in growing their client base, developing long-term relationships, contributing to the clinic culture, and becoming an active part of an expanding practice. An entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to learn about practice growth, communication, and client experience are highly valued.

We are looking for a chiropractor who is fully qualified, registered or eligible for registration to practise, and keen to continue developing both clinically and professionally. The successful candidate should have excellent communication skills, a caring and approachable manner, and the ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment.

New graduates will benefit from mentorship and support, while experienced chiropractors will have the opportunity to grow within an established and respected practice. An interest in family care, wellness care, pregnancy, paediatrics, rehabilitation, or adjusting techniques would be advantageous, although not essential.

The role offers the opportunity to build a long-term career within a supportive and professional team environment. We value personal growth, integrity, and a genuine passion for helping people improve their quality of life.

To apply, please send:

Your CV.
A covering email.
A short introductory video.

Applications should be sent to Yvonne
e-mail: pm@evchiropractic.co.uk

Closing date for applications: 8th June 2026.

Are you a qualified and experienced massage therapist looking to join a professional, friendly chiropractic clinic team? Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic on the Isle of Man is looking for a motivated therapist to work within our established practice, helping support our clients’ health, recovery, and wellbeing in a collaborative environment.

We are particularly interested in therapists with experience or additional training in sports massage, pregnancy massage, or lymphatic drainage massage. An interest in learning more about chiropractic care and working alongside chiropractors is essential.

This role is based within our clinic, and the successful applicant will be treating and supporting clinic clients as part of the wider team. We are looking for someone professional, approachable, caring, and reliable, with excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for helping people.

The position will initially begin with one shift per week, with the opportunity to increase hours as demand grows. A minimum of six hours per week will be offered, with individual shifts no longer than five hours. Some flexibility with evenings or weekends may be required.

There is flexibility for the role to be offered on either an employed or self-employed basis, depending on the experience and preferences of the successful candidate.

Applicants should hold a minimum Level 3 qualification in Sports Massage Therapy or equivalent, along with valid professional insurance and a good understanding of anatomy and physiology. Experience in a clinical or healthcare setting would be advantageous.

In return, we offer a welcoming and supportive clinic environment, marketing support, opportunities for internal referrals, and the chance to grow within an established healthcare practice.

To apply, please contact Claire at Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic, Douglas with your CV and a short introductory video by e-mail: reception@evchiropractic.co.uk

Serving drinks and looking after customers.
Supporting food service where required.
Keeping the bar area clean and safe.

Shift work, including evenings and weekends. Hours vary by site.

Friendly and approachable attitude.
Good communication skills.
Reliability and good timekeeping.

Positions are available across multiple Heron & Brearley pubs around the Isle of Man.

The Assistant Manager supports the General Manager in the day?to?day running of the pub, ensuring excellent customer service, strong team performance, and compliance with company standards. They play a key role in leading shifts, developing the team, and maintaining a safe, welcoming environment.

 

A minimum of 2 years’ experience in a hospitality role is required.

 

Being an approved Responsible Person is an advantage, but not essential. If you are not currently approved, you must be willing and able to apply.

 

What the job involves:

Creating and managing staff rotas.
Leading shifts and supporting the team during busy periods.
Overseeing stock ordering, deliveries and stock control.
Ensuring high standards of customer service and venue presentation.
Supporting training and development of bar staff.
Handling cashing?up and basic administrative tasks.
Ensuring compliance with licensing laws, health and safety, and company procedures.
Acting as a key point of contact for staff and management. 
What we’re looking for:

At least 2 years’ experience in a hospitality role.
Strong communication and people skills.
Ability to lead by example and motivate a team.
Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
Confidence in decision?making and problem-solving.
Reliability, professionalism and a positive attitude.
Willingness to take on responsibility, including applying to be a Responsible Person if required. 
Working hours. 

 

Shift-based work, including evenings, weekends and bank holidays. Flexibility is important.

 

Training provided 

 

Training will be provided in stock management, leadership, compliance, and operational procedures. Support is available for those applying to become a Responsible Person.

Locations:

Roles are available across various Heron & Brearley pubs on the Isle of Man.

Applications to be made via the website: https://careers.hb.im/job/assistant-manager-pubs-5843907?source=hb.im -

Notes
We are looking for a passionate, forward-thinking full-time Chef/Cook to work alongside our Head Chef at Vibe, a multi award-winning plant based café and restaurant in Douglas. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is genuinely passionate about food, creativity, seasonality and plant based cooking, and who wants to further their career in a kitchen where innovation, freedom and customer connection are at the heart of everything we do.

Our Head Chef is a double award-winning plant based chef, winning the Isle of Man Manx Menu award two years running, alongside accolades for innovation and creativity. We want someone to join the team who is excited and passionate about what can be achieved with plant based food. 

By day, Vibe is a vibrant café serving creative brunches & nourishing lunches. You will use the mornings to check in deliveries, prepare dish ingredients from scratch, cook from recipes and set up the kitchen for service, then cook to order during Lunch service. We close for a break then reopen for dinner. Afternoons are for prep and restocking. By night, the café transforms into an intimate restaurant space offering a seasonal small plates menu designed for a relaxed tapas-style dining experience. Dishes are made fresh to order and fired out throughout the evening, allowing guests to build their own tasting menu experience and enjoy food at their own pace. Closed Sunday evenings, Mondays and Tuesdays. 

Our menus change every two months and are heavily inspired by the seasons, local produce and foraged ingredients. We are passionate about pickling, fermenting, dehydrating and preserving ingredients throughout the year to maximise flavour and minimise waste. We work closely with local farms and growers, and we are incredibly lucky to also have our own rooftop garden filled with edible flowers, herbs and fresh ingredients used throughout our food and cocktail menus.

THE ROLE
We are looking for someone who:
Has a genuine passion for plant based food and modern cooking. Is creative, enthusiastic and career driven. Is consistent, has attention to detail and good plating presentation skills. Loves working with seasonal ingredients and flavour-led cooking. Is organised, fast and confident working unsupervised. Can confidently manage their own prep and service section. Thrives in a small close-knit team environment. Is willing to work split shifts. Wants to contribute ideas and continue learning and evolving.

This is a multitasking role within a very small and intimate kitchen team. We are looking for someone who understands that small independent hospitality is hard work but incredibly rewarding. None of us are afraid of getting our hands dirty and doing whatever needs to be done to achieve our goals. Chefs are responsible for washing their own utensils and pots during service and the front of house handles the containers, boards and dishwasher support throughout the day. 
To apply send us your CV and cover letter to hello@vibecafe.im

Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role:
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
What You'll Be Doing:
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You:
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer:
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply:
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im

Notes
Crema Limited are excited to advertise the role of Store Manager within their busy Peel Road Drive Thru Starbucks site.

This role contributes to Starbucks success by leading a team of store partners to create and maintain the Starbucks Experience for our customers and partners.

The Store Manager is required to regularly exercise initiative in managing the overall operation of the store. In particular, a majority of time is spent managing and coaching the store partners, making people decisions (e.g. development, recruitment, deploying), ensuring customer satisfaction and product quality, managing the store’s financial performance, and managing health and safety and security within the store.

The Store Manager is responsible for acting in accordance with and as an ambassador of Starbucks guiding principles, culture and values; embracing the coffee culture and keeping it at the heart of everything we do.

The role will suit an enthusiastic individual with a proven track record of working within a busy hospitality setting, and as a minimum having managed or supervised a team previously.

The role requires full flexibility, with some evening and weekend availability key to the position. 

As well as offering a fun, team environment, fantastic career opportunities and beverage/food discounts, the role also comes with a very competitive pay and benefits package.

If you believe you are suitable for the role, and are excited at the prospect of this opportunity, please submit a cover letter summarising why you are the right person for this role, as well as your CV, to Darren Kerruish, District Manager via e-mail at darren.kerruish@cafefortune.uk

Experience acting as an Application SME with deep understanding of system architecture. Knowledge of integrations, data flows, dependencies and system limitations. Experience designing event-driven data solutions and configuring Kafka topics. Proven ability to translate business requirements into clear technical designs.Experience as the specialist for third-party SaaS and low-code tools driving adoption. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to recommend secure, scalable solutions. Experience modernising legacy technologies with supported enterprise solutions (desirable). Exposure to Java or Python in context of event streaming or API integration (desirable). Familiarity with data visualisation, dashboards or AI-enabled tooling (desirable).

Notes
The role holder will engage with business users to understand their requirements then model and prepare statistical queries or visual representations and dashboards that provide the necessary evidence and assurance to solve business queries. Understanding and preparing data to support business decision making is a key element of this role and involves data wrangling, cleansing, enrichment and feedback on data quality to resolve issues in production or test systems which impact the analysis.

Responsibilities & Duties

Data Management & Quality:

Establish and manage key data management competencies such as data quality assurance, metadata management, master data management, and data modelling.
Support data governance controls and business data owners to maintain high-quality data across the organization.
Support data governance and control frameworks to maintain data quality and data integrity.
Document and maintain source-to-target mappings, data flows, and data definitions, ensuring compliance with data standards and strategy.
Design and facilitate user self-service of tactical data requests and report working with data analysts and business users.

Data Insights & Analysis

Engage with business stakeholders to understand their requirements, translating these into actionable data insights, dashboards, and reports.
Re-engineer manual data flows for scalability and improved efficiency in reporting working with other departments such as IT to build effective data capture in source systems to meet analytical requirements.
Build accessible datasets for self-service analysis and ensure the organization is equipped with the right data infrastructure.
Build our advanced analytics capability using tools such as Python, PySpark, Machine Learning utilising statistical data techniques.

Team Collaboration & Development:

Collaborate with Data Analysts, business SME's, and other teams to ensure successful implementation of our data analytics function.
Monitor team workflows, resource allocation, and project progress, while ensuring team members' professional development through training and development.

Skills and Experience

Proven experience in a Data Analyst/ Business Analyst (data focussed), or similar role.
Data modelling experience. 
Advanced data visualisation and report creation skills (Power BI reports and dashboards).
Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Data cleansing and data enrichment experience.
Advanced knowledge of SQL data queries and joins.
Knowledge and experience in data governance. 

Apply via our careers portal: http://nedbank.peoplehr.net/Pages/JobBoard/Opening.aspx?v=5c2c64f3-a7da-40bc-89f3-32813cc31fce

Notes
Key Responsibilities:
Develop the overall promotional strategy across Sportsbook and Gaming products, aligned with business KPIs and customer behaviour.
Own the promotional calendars, ensuring coverage of key sporting events, gaming seasonality, and commercial objectives.
Identify opportunities to introduce new, compelling promotional formats and offers that differentiate our brands in their respective markets.
Design and manage a wide range of promotional mechanics such as Bet & Gets, Deposit Offers, Cashback, Missions, Tournaments, Price Boosts, cross-product offers.
Work with Product and Tech teams to improve promotional tools, automation, and customer experience.
Oversee end-to-end campaign delivery: briefing, setup, QA, launch, monitoring, and post-campaign review.
Monitor campaign performance and make real-time optimisations based on data, trading impact, and customer response.
Ensure promotions are commercially efficient, clearly communicated, and fully compliant with responsible gambling and regulatory standards.
Track key metrics including participation, incremental revenue, retention uplift, and bonus efficiency.
Partner with BI and Data teams to analyse promotional results and identify actionable insights.
Produce clear, practical reporting to inform future campaign planning and improvements.
Work closely with Sportsbook, Casino, CRM, Trading, Product, Compliance, and Customer Support teams to ensure smooth execution.
Support CRM and Lifecycle teams to integrate promotions into customer journeys and segmentation strategies.
Collaborate with Trading to balance customer appeal with sustainable risk management.
Team Contribution:
Mentor junior team members and help upskill the wider commercial teams on promotional strategy and mechanics.
Manage external suppliers and vendors involved in promotional tooling or gamification solutions.
Provide input into product roadmaps, commercial forecasts, and budget planning.
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in online gaming or sportsbook promotions,CRM, or product marketing.
Commercially minded, with a good balance of creativity and analytical thinking.
Strong understanding of Sportsbook mechanics, betting behaviour, and gaming product ecosystems.
Proven track record in designing, delivering, and optimising high- impact promotional campaigns.
Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in tools like Excel, PowerBI, or similar.
Experience working with promotional tools, campaign management systems, and bonus engines.
Organised, detail-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, live environment.
Confident communicator who can work effectively with a range of stakeholders.

Additional related, duties may be assigned by the Line Manager in line with business.

For more details and to apply contact talent@silverspin.com

Notes
Experienced Project Manager.

Project Management, Groundworks, Drainage & Site Liaison.

About the Role:

You’ll be the go-to person across multiple sites, managing crews, keeping clients happy and making sure work gets measured, recorded and signed off properly. Day-to-day, you’ll be attending site meetings, liaising with our site managers, overseeing groundwork teams and working closely with the QS to verify completed work. It’s hands-on, varied and you’ll need to confidently juggle several projects at once.

You’ve got solid experience in groundwork or drainage project management - not necessarily years in the role, but you understand how sites operate, you’re comfortable handling conversations with both staff and clients and you’re organised enough to keep projects moving and problems solved.

DGC is a tight-knit, growing team delivering a real variety of work across the island. We take pride in running clean, well-organised and tightly managed sites, with a strong focus on health, safety and high standards of workmanship. You’ll be working alongside experienced site managers and crews who know their stuff. We look after our people, and if you’re relocating from the UK, we can help sort accommodation.

Requirements:

Proven experience managing groundwork or drainage projects on-site. Demonstrable experience liaising with clients and managing site teams. Valid driving licence. Health & Safety awareness and site-specific inductions.

Location:
Isle of Man.

Salary:
Competitive.

For more details and to apply contact info@dgc.im

Notes
You'll be at the heart of our pricing process, preparing estimates, managing variations, and handling contract administration across our drainage and groundwork projects. This role combines technical accuracy with client communication - you'll liaise with site teams, clients, and suppliers to keep projects on track financially and contractually. You'll work with both JCT600 and NEC frameworks, dealing with change events, compensation events, and contract variations as they arise. We're a hands-on team based on the Isle of Man. If you're relocating from the UK or internationally, we'll support you in making the move.

 

Requirements:

Fluent in JCT600 and NEC contract management, including variations and change events.

Proven experience as a Quantity Surveyor in construction or civil engineering.

Strong understanding of drainage, groundworks, or civils projects.

Ability to produce accurate estimates, valuations, and contract claims

Professional qualification (MRICS, RICS Associate, or equivalent) or equivalent proven experience.

Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.

Location in isle of Man.

Salary is competitive.

For more details and to apply contact info@dgc.im

The role ensures that all operational activity is conducted in line with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and company policies, while maintaining high levels of safety, quality, and service delivery. The Operations Manager works closely with the Chief Executive, regulatory bodies, and internal teams to deliver operational excellence, manage risk, and support the ongoing development of the business. Essential candidate requirements: Proven experience in operations management within fuel, logistics, industrial, or similarly regulated environments. Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental compliance requirements. Experience managing complex operational processes and multi-site activities. Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to manage and motivate teams. Strong organisational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Personal characteristics include: Strong leadership presence with a calm and decisive approach. Highly organised and detail-oriented with a focus on safety and compliance. Proactive and resilient, with the ability to manage operational challenges effectively. Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills. Hands-on, practical, and solutions-focused.  Desirable skills, experience and attributes: Experience in petroleum, energy, or aviation fuel operations. Knowledge of regulatory frameworks relating to fuel storage and distribution. Experience working with regulatory authorities. A full role profile is available upon request. To apply please forward your up-to-date CV and a covering letter to Richard Gelder, Chief Executive at RichardG@mp.im

Our client seeks a Management Accountant to join their Finance Team. Role Profile: You In this role, you'll play a key part in supporting the financial health and strategic direction of the Group. You'll contribute to the delivery of accurate, insightful financial reporting and analysis, helping to inform decision-making and drive performance across the Group. Joining the bank and its mission to provide financial excellence by monitoring performance, managing costs, assessing risks, and delivering strategic insights that drive informed decision-making. You'll report to the Head of Management Accounting and the Group Financial Controller, supporting the Finance Director and wider Finance Team in delivering accurate financial reporting and analysis across the Group. Key Responsibilities: Prepare accurate and timely monthly management accounts the bank and its subsidiaries. Support financial reporting with journal entries, reconciliations, VAT and tax filings, and management pack preparation. Drive continuous improvement in reporting through KPIs, variance analysis, and trend insights. Collaborate with teams across the business, respond to financial queries, and support team development. Provide cover for senior finance roles and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Key Skills and Experience: A recognised accountant qualification, be part-qualified, or have relevant industry experience. Knowledge of IFRS, UK Accounting Standards, and ERP systems (preferably SUN and Xero). Working knowledge of relational database theory sufficient to perform database queries. Excellent Excel and numeracy skills. Strong organisation and communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. All applications will be treated with the utmost discretion.

An opportunity has arisen within the Council to join the Electrical Services team within the Environment & Regeneration Department to shape the Council’s electrical strategy, deliver visible public projects e.g., public lighting, decorative lighting, open?spaces and regeneration and lead digital/Smart City transformation.

You must be degree qualified or hold an equivalent professional qualification in Electrical Engineering or have a proven track record of successful high quality professional and managerial experience in one or more of the specialist engineering areas of the service (electrical, painting, civils and projects). Notes
Are you an experienced and dynamic leader looking to make a real impact in primary care? Peel Group Practice is seeking a highly motivated Practice Manager to lead our dedicated team and help drive the future of our well-established and forward-thinking GP practice.
About Us:
Peel Group Practice is a friendly, patient-focused NHS GP surgery providing high-quality care to our local community. With a strong commitment to clinical excellence, staff wellbeing, and continuous improvement, we pride ourselves on being a supportive and innovative place to work.
We are a three partner practice serving 9250 patients, with a skilled multidisciplinary team including GPs, Nurses,  HCAs, Pharmacy Technician, and administrative staff. We work closely with our Manx Care and wider health system partners to deliver outstanding care.
Role Summary:
As Practice Manager, you will lead the operational management of the Practice and ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. You’ll be responsible for strategic planning, HR, finance, patient services, compliance, and implementing changes in line with Manx Care policy and local needs.
Key responsibilities:
Provide strategic leadership and effective management across all areas of the Practice.
Oversee HR and staffing, including recruitment, training, and performance management – with the assistance of the practice support officer.
Manage Practice finances, budgets, and reporting.
Ensure compliance with local CQC, Health & Safety, GDPR, and other regulatory frameworks.
Optimise use of clinical systems and digital tools.
Drive continuous improvement in service delivery, patient experience, and staff wellbeing.
Opportunity to work in a progressive, stable, and well-organised environment.
What We’re Looking For:
Proven leadership and management experience (ideally in Primary Care or healthcare).
Strong business and financial acumen.
Excellent interpersonal and organisational skills.
Working knowledge of NHS structures and policies (desirable).
A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving and innovation.
We Offer:
Competitive salary (negotiable).
Pension.
Death in service. 
Annual leave and sick pay.
Supportive, forward-thinking team.
A DBS check will be required – paid for by the Practice.
How to Apply:
Please submit your CV and a covering letter outlining your suitability for the role to:
peelmgt@gov.im or Peel Group Practice, Management Team, Albany Road, Peel, IM5 1HU.
For informal enquiries, contact 693890 Closing date: 5th June 2026.
